mapper.select: SELECT tmpl_cd AS "tmplCd", tmpl_nm AS "tmplNm", sys_yn AS "formTy", doc_kind AS "docKind", cycle_cd AS "cycleCd", rule_yn AS "ruleYn" FROM sp_schedule_cycle_management_form_r_000( #{coCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmplCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmplNm, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT tmpl_cd AS "tmplCd", tmpl_nm AS "tmplNm", base_dt AS "baseDt", cycle_cd AS "cycleCd", nonwork_rule AS "nonworkRule", due_time AS "dueTime", dept_cd AS "deptCd", dept_nm AS "deptNm", user_id AS "userId", user_nm AS "userNm", use_yn AS "useYn", details::text AS "details" FROM sp_schedule_cycle_management_r_000( #{coCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmplCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: CALL sp_tbl_schedule_task_regen_c_000( #{coCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmplCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{dates, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{dueTime, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assignUserId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmMinutes, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{userId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.co_cd AS "coCd", r.tmpl_cd AS "tmplCd", r.cycle_cd AS "cycleCd", r.nonwork_rule AS "nonworkRule", r.base_dt AS "baseDt", r.due_time AS "dueTime", r.dept_cd AS "deptCd", r.user_id AS "userId", COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('detailTy', x.detail_ty, 'val1', x.val1, 'val2', x.val2) ORDER BY x.seq) FROM tbl_schedule_rule_detail x WHERE x.co_cd = r.co_cd AND x.tmpl_cd = r.tmpl_cd ), '[]'::jsonb)::text AS "details" FROM tbl_schedule_rule r JOIN tbl_company_template ct ON ct.co_cd = r.co_cd AND ct.tmpl_cd = r.tmpl_cd AND upper(COALESCE(ct.use_yn, 'N')) = 'Y' WHERE upper(COALESCE(r.use_yn, 'N')) = 'Y' ORDER BY r.co_cd, r.tmpl_cd
